title: English Tafsir Ibn Kathir — cleaned canonical source files
method: Group records only when complete text strings are exactly identical. Preserve original text and every distinct Ayah reference. No trimming, rewriting, translation, or Arabic text modification.
preservation_rule: Active canonical source data used by ApnaQuran. Exact duplicate commentary passages are consolidated, and all distinct original Ayah references are retained in ayahs[]. Untouched upstream files and their original checksums are preserved in ../original-source/.
checksum_method: Git blob SHA-1 for exact cleaned source file bytes; original_git_blob_sha points to the untouched upstream backup.
